# Mapper

> A Java type mapper and coercer library that provides generalized conversion between data types, with 60+ built-in converters and OSGi support.

Key facts:
- Java 21, built with Maven 3.9.4 (wrapper included)
- Maven multi-module project, 8 modules
- Pluggable `Converter<S,T>` architecture with runtime registration
- 60+ built-in converters covering numeric, temporal, boolean, UUID, and string types
- OSGi deployment via Apache Karaf 4.4.7 with dynamic service discovery
- Optional Joda-Time extension module for legacy date/time compatibility
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, and build commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with module structure, technology stack, build commands, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup instructions and contribution guidelines

## Modules — Core

- [mapper-api/pom.xml](mapper-api/pom.xml): Core interfaces — Coercer, ExtendableCoercer, Converter, ConverterFactory, ConverterRegistry, Formatter
- [mapper-impl/pom.xml](mapper-impl/pom.xml): DefaultCoercer engine, DefaultConverterFactory, Java8Module with 60+ converters and 12 formatters
- [mapper-jodatime/pom.xml](mapper-jodatime/pom.xml): Joda-Time extension — StringToLocalDateConverter, LocalDateToStringConverter, and LocalDateFormatter

## Modules — OSGi & Deployment

- [mapper-osgi/pom.xml](mapper-osgi/pom.xml): ExtendableCoercerService — extends DefaultCoercer with dynamic OSGi converter binding
- [features/pom.xml](features/pom.xml): Karaf feature descriptors for mapper-core, mapper-jodatime, and mapper-osgi
- [kar/pom.xml](kar/pom.xml): Karaf Archive (KAR) packaging for deployment

## Modules — Testing & Quality

- [mapper-itest/pom.xml](mapper-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests running in a Karaf 4.4.7 container
- [mapper-reports/pom.xml](mapper-reports/pom.xml): JaCoCo code coverage aggregation across all modules
